keywords: Person + と + 一緒に + verb.
I eat lunch with a friend.
Would you like to study together tomorrow?
I went to Kyoto with my family.
formation: Person + と + 一緒に + verb.
restrictions: と identifies the companion; it is omitted when the companion is obvious.
mistake: 一緒に modifies an action, rather than linking nouns by itself.

segments.role: Describe doing an activity together. Person + と + 一緒に + verb.
